title: Hydraulic Cylinders - Volume Displacement
description: Calculate the volumetric displacement of hydraulic cylinders using cylinder area and stroke length.

components.content:
## Hydraulic Cylinders - Volume Displacement

The volume displacement of a hydraulic cylinder is calculated using:

**q = A × s / 231**

Where:
- **q** = volume displacement (gal)
- **A** = cylinder area (in²)
- **s** = cylinder stroke (in)

### Conversion Factors
- 1 gal (US) = 3.785 dm³ (liter) = 3.785×10⁻³ m³
- 1 in² = 6.452 cm²
